title: How Looply Works: From Vector Images to 60 FPS Production CSS & Reanimated Animations
description: Learn how Looply transforms imported images into production animations through timeline keyframing, real-time stage inspection, and clean zero-runtime code generation.

steps.title: Import Graphic Assets
steps.desc: Drag and drop PNG, JPEG, WebP, or SVG graphics directly into your workspace. Assets are loaded locally into browser storage and instantly ready for canvas staging.

steps.title: Compose Layers on the Stage Canvas
steps.desc: Add assets to the canvas stage as independent layers. Configure stage resolution, background color, layer z-index stacking, initial position, width/height, and transform origin.

steps.title: Animate with Timeline Keyframes & Easing
steps.desc: Move the playhead across the time ruler and insert keyframes. Looply linearly interpolates properties between keyframes and applies your choice of easing or spring physics.

steps.title: Export Production CSS & Reanimated v4
steps.desc: Export mathematically precise CSS keyframe rules alongside an index.html demo file or drop-in React Native Reanimated v4 (Latest) component with zero runtime overhead.
